title: An Act to Update the State's Informed Consent Laws Regarding Drug-induced Abortion

summary.text: This bill requires a health care professional who is obtaining a woman's informed consent to a drug-induced abortion to provide the woman with specific information about the potential ability of qualified health care professionals to reverse the effects of the abortion.
